editorial:
Imagine walking through a foggy, old-school London where a scary killer is picking off victims one by one. You get two main guys to follow: DI Rowan, a grumpy detective who has seen it all, and Judge Lomax, a man who loves handing out the toughest sentences possible in court. The vibe is a mix of a gritty police procedural and a creepy slasher flick. It feels like a dark rainy night where you never know who to trust, and the tension builds as the detective tries to connect the dots while the judge continues his reign of terror in the courtroom.

What really works here is the contrast between the law and the actual crimes happening on the street. The acting is solid, though the pacing can feel a bit slow in the middle. If you love old-school crime mysteries with a dark twist, you will enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a weekend binge. It looks great in high definition, making those gloomy London streets feel even more real.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the killer is actually Judge Lomax himself. He spent his days punishing people in court, but spent his nights killing people to feel powerful. He thought he was above the law because he was the one making the rules. DI Rowan catches on to his pattern and traps him in a final confrontation. The movie wraps up with the judge finally getting the kind of harsh sentence he used to give to others.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old British crime stories and twist endings.
